events.verdict: Jovic (MIA) moves alongside Holiday's (POR) path while briefly resting an arm across his back and marginal body contact occurs before Jovic cleanly blocks the driving shot attempt.
Jovic (MIA) maintains his arms within the frame of his body and does not deliver illegal contact to Avdija (POR) during the screen.
Holiday (POR) is already in Mitchell's (MIA) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the pick.
Wiggins (MIA) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Avdija (POR) prior to any incidental arm contact occurring.
Sharpe (POR) aligns himself alongside Jaquez Jr.'s (MIA) path and absorbs the marginal body contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Powell (MIA) makes marginal contact with Clingan's (POR) right arm while reaching for the ball and Clingan briefly bobbles the ball before securing it.
Avdija (POR) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.

Replay review of the foul called on Mitchell (MIA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Mitchell's hand is momentarily on Avdija's (POR) side before he quickly removes it and the contact during Avdija's jump shot attempt is marginal. As Clingan (POR) has imminent possession at the time of the whistle, play correctly resumes with POR retaining possession.
Powell (MIA) clamps and holds Avdija's (POR) left arm, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Camara (POR) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Sharpe (POR) commits a take foul on Mitchell (MIA).
Holiday (POR) commits a take foul on Jovic (MIA).
Jovic (MIA) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
